definitions.gloss: extraordinary; out of the ordinary; non-everyday
definitions.explanation: Something outside the scope of daily routine. Often used positively to describe special experiences, travel, or events that break from the mundane.

examples.japanese: {非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The nice thing about travel is that you can enjoy an extraordinary space.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧よい⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧だ。
examples.english: Camping is a good opportunity to give children an out-of-the-ordinary experience.

notes:
Formed by prefixing ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-) to ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧ (daily life/routine). Popular in marketing and lifestyle writing to promote travel, events, and luxury experiences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ (savor the extraordinary)
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (extraordinary experience)
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧ (extraordinary space/setting)
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}{的|てき}な (extraordinary, unusual)

Used as a noun ({非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧) or as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({非日常|ひにちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧). Has a generally positive nuance, unlike the English word "abnormal."
